replies.author: CakeDoesMC
replies.body:
This looks really nifty in terms of design, but I have a few suggestions for you.
1. Don't make a direct path to the monument. Makes it easier to attack and easier to defend- which isn't a good thing in DTM.
2. You might want different lanes, because this map seems similar to clay wars and it's going to be annoying just getting to the other side.
3. Spawn is a little small tbh.
4. Whole map is kind of small- unless this is like a 16 team map you should probably make it bigger.
